fact: The June 2023 final SNDS-II document sets the strategy for 2023-2030, records that the final evaluation of the SNDS-1 was completed in May 2022, and schedules a mid-term evaluation in 2026 and a final one in 2030.
title: Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique (SNDS) 2023-2030 - Document final
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT), Madagascar
